name: Email Obfuscator
description: Obfuscates email addresses in rendered HTML responses to deter harvesting bots (a deterrent, not real protection).
project_description: Email Obfuscator (a.k.a. Email Obfuscation Response Filter) registers a kernel RESPONSE event subscriber that scans each generated response body with regular expressions and obfuscates the email addresses it finds. Mailto links have their address reversed and get inline onfocus/onmousedown handlers that restore the real address on the first user interaction; plain-text emails get a hidden display:none span (optionally marked data-nosnippet) inserted in the middle. Admin pages, ignored routes (configured in settings.php), Ajax webform submissions and emails inside HTML tags/attributes are skipped, and invalid addresses are left untouched. The goal is to reduce casual email scraping and spam; it is a deterrent, not a guarantee, since the address is still delivered to the browser.
